objective: Require government ID for legal-name edits and separately verify legal identity before any cash withdrawal.
seasonPolicy: No Season 1 or Season 2 rule edits

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Add member and admin identity verification routes while preserving normal account, call and payout behavior.
preservedBehaviors: User login, normal profile editing, navigation, and existing payouts remain governed by backend authorization

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Register explicit secure ID review routes and block unapproved profile legal-name mutations.
preservedBehaviors: Existing root stack screens, role checks, password recovery, and private information settings remain accessible

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Keep all cash payouts denied unless membership, legal-ID and payout beneficiary identity are verified.
preservedBehaviors: Existing AdMob first-view behavior, financial ledgers, earning balances, QMP and cash activation switches remain unchanged

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Enforce private government-ID storage policies and fail-closed backend payout and legal-name access checks.
preservedBehaviors: Existing database RLS, protected official identity, payout idempotency, finance journal and old Android client guards remain intact

mandatoryGates: Main staging Supabase migration and DB tests
Real device RC verified no AdMob/navigation regression
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: GitHub main source commit 7a3c706d44ab05389a4aa9c4a1bba82ad22f6395 was inspected for canonical profile edits and payout RPCs on 2026-11-18. Production OTA and Main Supabase live schema were not verified; DEV only.
chosenApproach: Introduce a private government-ID review table and storage bucket plus a DB name-change trigger; wrap existing canonical and legacy withdrawal RPCs to retain their money logic while checking fresh independent legal-ID and membership status.
selectionRationale: Direct client profile updates allowed unsupervised legal-name edits and membership is_verified did not demonstrate government-ID identity. The finance request and payout endpoints require server-controlled identity and beneficiary matching without reimplementing the journal or activating finance switches.
preserveBehaviors: Normal BUKLOD profile mobile, address, faith and other non-name edits remain available without new ID review.
Canonical and old R38 finance balances, minimums, payout idempotency and official System Admin isolation remain unchanged.
AdMob rendering, instant dashboard tabs and existing Expo production runtime are not touched.
The new legal-name verification routes are additive and protected by BUKLOD auth and role checks.
acceptanceChecks: Review or direct name edit must fail closed without approved government ID.
Valid private ID submission requires explicit consent and human review; ordinary users cannot view another member ID.
Withdrawal request and final paid RPC refuse pending, rejected, inactive or unapproved membership and unmatched GCash beneficiary names.
Run focused legal ID/economy/navigation Node contract tests and separate Supabase staging DB security tests.
Verify AdMob first-view and dashboard speed before any staging candidate; no production OTA until separate release approval.
alternativeApproaches: Use only profiles.is_verified as a payout flag (rejected: it verifies membership, not government-ID legal name).
Apply a client-only name/withdrawal check (rejected: older Android builds and direct RPC calls bypass it).
Replace the financial engine entirely (rejected: risks existing balances, idempotency and AdMob/QMP behavior).
